mechanism: Deleveraging flush: 1-day open-interest change and 1-day return both at or below their trailing-90-day 20th percentile -> long 3 days, BTC and ETH perps
orthogonality: Bets on forced-seller exhaustion after liquidation cascades, a state the closed survivors never traded; differs from v55 oi_squeeze (OI build-up against price, rejected).
weekend_coverage: Binance USD-M klines and metrics are 24/7; no signal vacuum.
knowledge_disclosure: v55 oi_squeeze development (2022-2023) was opened and lost; v57 conditions on the opposite OI state. The 2024-2025 confirmation is binding.
limitations: PnL uses USD-M close-to-close returns without funding cash flows.
